scope: Static task/control source audit; no native runtime; installed PhysX/SAPIEN versions require separate qualification

findings.pickcube: Success combines goal proximity and robot static, not sustained support/release. Extra observations include is_grasped and goal_pos even without state-specific object-pose fields.
findings.pushcube: Success combines planar proximity and an upper z bound; does not independently enforce penetration or sustained support.
findings.rotation: Level0/1/2/3 registered; AllegroHandRightTouch. Unsigned clipped angular increments accumulate; requires signed palm-relative independent scorer. qf is a clipped PD estimate, not measured actuator torque.
findings.allegro: Joint PD position and delta modes; base stiffness400, damping10, force_limit50; controller targets differ from observed joints. Touch subclass adds FSR impulse magnitudes, not calibrated tactile images.

reuse: Reuse native task/recording; independently score physics and input privileges. Keep upstream success separate.
minimal_experiments: PushCube normal episode plus below-table negative
PickCube goal coincidence without sustained grasp negative
Rotation oscillation, palm-only motion, drop, reset isolation negatives
remaining: all asset licenses and dependency versions
